I estimated these from structural reasoning about the cell DAG, not from the NAS-Bench-201 tables, so treat them as priors. Most interaction claims with a strict three-dataset consistency requirement fail, so I kept most values low. The highest values are for cases where the condition removes an alternative path (e.g., claims 7, 14), making the edited edge the sole input to a node.
